### [`v0.21.4`](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/releases/tag/0.21.4)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/compare/0.21.3...0.21.4)

#### Changes

- Add `AssetRegistry` export ([#​2885](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2885)) and `react-native-web/asset-registry` entry point ([#​2886](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2886))
- Share `AssetRegistry` between CJS and ESM builds ([#​2887](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2887))
- Remove deprecation warnings for APIs that React Native does not deprecate ([#​2892](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2892))

#### New contributors

- [@​zoontek](https://redirect.github.com/zoontek) made their first contribution in [#​2865](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2865)
- [@​byCedric](https://redirect.github.com/byCedric) made their first contribution in [#​2885](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2885)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/compare/0.21.3...0.21.4>

### [`v0.21.3`](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/releases/tag/0.21.3)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/compare/0.21.2...0.21.3)

#### What's Changed

- `Image`: new `onLoad`, `onLoadStart`, `onLoadEnd` or `onError` callbacks (e.g. inline functions) no longer abort and restart the image load. Fixes [#​2850](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2850). By [@​AbdullahAnsarii](https://redirect.github.com/AbdullahAnsarii) in [#​2851](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2851)
- `useColorScheme`: the hook now subscribes once per component instead of on every render. Fixes [#​2848](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2848). By [@​huytdps13400](https://redirect.github.com/huytdps13400) in [#​2853](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2853)
- `InputAccessoryView` is now exported from the package entry. Fixes [#​2806](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/issues/2806).

#### New Contributors

- [@​huytdps13400](https://redirect.github.com/huytdps13400) made their first contribution in [#​2856](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2856)
- [@​AbdullahAnsarii](https://redirect.github.com/AbdullahAnsarii) made their first contribution in [#​2851](https://redirect.github.com/necolas/react-native-web/pull/2851)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/necolas/react-native-web/compare/0.21.2...0.21.3>
